name: motor_set_position
evidence: OS motor class (vtable 0x000339d4 +0x18): writes the current position +0x20, interrupts off

name: motor_claim
evidence: waits up to n ticks while vtable +0x2c says the motor is owned, then makes the current task its owner (+0x2c) with an exit call 0x000169f0

name: motor_release
evidence: clears the owner +0x2c (and its exit call), then vtable +0xc

name: motor_owner_exit
evidence: exit call of a motor's owner task: stops the move (vtable +0xf4), else logs error 0x8e

name: motor_poll_1ms
evidence: every 4th call (+0x34) of the IO interrupt: the target switch seen in +0x5c polls, then the after-run (+0x54 / +100), then stop (vtable +0x10c); Optimus motor 0x000351e8

name: motor_poll_all
evidence: every motor of the list 0x000315f4: vtable +0xe4 (motor_poll_1ms)

name: motor_poll_all_isr
evidence: same as 0x00016b7c, called at the end of the IO interrupt io_isr [0x000114b0]

name: motor_arm_target
evidence: vtable +0xac: target switch (switch_rec_d2d4 record), debounce 2, after-run from table +0x14, target +0x22

name: motor_move_task
evidence: task +0x18 of a motor: start delay +4, start (vtable +0xac), wait at most vtable +0x24 ticks (0x00016830: 0x1d4 = 468), arrival (+0x94 / +0xa4) or fault (+0x8c / +0x9c) callbacks, stop (+0x104)

name: motor_moving
evidence: task_running(motor task id +0x18)

name: motor_goto_check
evidence: vtable +0x34 then +0xec (motor_goto); error 0x8f when not allowed

name: motor_goto_wait
evidence: vtable +0x44 (goto) then sleeps while vtable +0x64 (moving); true when the position +0x20 is the target

name: motor_goto
evidence: starts the move task 0x00016c88 toward a position unless already there or moving there

name: motor_stop
evidence: kills the move task and stops the motor (vtable +0x10c)

name: motor_off_locked
evidence: vtable +0x10c with interrupts off

name: motor_position_faulty
evidence: the fault count of a position (table +0x1c) is above 2

name: motor_fault_set
evidence: sets or clears the fault count of a position (table +0x1c)

name: motor_fault_count
evidence: adds one to the fault count of a position (table +0x1c), at most 3

name: snd_fiq
evidence: the sound FIQ (4 kHz, knowledge/sam_hardware): acknowledges the AIC, then snd_fiq_mix

name: snd_fiq_mix
evidence: writes 12 samples to 0x0109f000, steps every active channel's script (0x00037b94 + n*0xa0, +0x98) and the volume ramps 0x00038274

name: snd_chan_script_step
evidence: runs the channel's script opcodes (table 0x0003249c) until one yields (2); counts +0x84 against +0x80

name: snd_op_end
evidence: script opcode 0: frees the channel when its ramps are over and +0x84 reached +0x80, else waits

name: snd_chan_free
evidence: clears the channel's active flags (+0x98, voices +0x36, ramps +0x9b) and gives back their volume

name: snd_chan_free_locked
evidence: snd_chan_free with interrupts off

name: snd_voice_step
evidence: one voice: stops it (+0x36 = 0) at the end of its sample (first word), else mixes it

name: snd_voice_reset
evidence: clears a voice's state for sample formats 1-3 (sample header +7)

name: snd_op_ramp
evidence: script opcode: starts a volume ramp (0x00038274 record)

name: snd_op_voice_start
evidence: script opcode: starts a voice on a sample (bank in the top byte, window 0x04800000)

name: snd_op_voice_stop
evidence: script opcode: stops the voices of a mask

name: snd_op_set_8c
evidence: script opcode: channel +0x8c = DAT_00032494

name: snd_op_set_88
evidence: script opcode: channel +0x88 = DAT_00032498

name: snd_op_route
evidence: script opcode: sets a routing bit (+0x68 + n, +0x70)

name: snd_op_wait
evidence: script opcode: waits n FIQ steps (+0x7c)

name: snd_op_wait_voices
evidence: script opcode: waits while the voices of a mask play (+0x36)

name: snd_call_playing
evidence: true when a call is on one of the 8 channels (+0x94 with +0x98 set); used by bg_entry_eval and the left eject

name: coil_pulse_pending
evidence: true while a pulse handle is queued (0x00031434 list) or still holds its coil slot (+0xc)

name: coil_slot_of
evidence: the coil's slot index (coil - 1, below 0x28) and its table record 0x040ce3d4; error 0x40 otherwise

name: coil_slot_time
evidence: the slot's pulse time field (+0x18 of 0x00035b10 + n*0x28)

name: coil_slot_start
evidence: fills a coil slot (time +0x18, end callback +4, state 3, on +0x27, handle +0xc) and runs the start callback

name: coil_pulse_queue
evidence: queues a pulse in the list 0x00031434..0x00031438 (error 0x41 when full); returns its handle

name: coil_pulse_queue_wait
evidence: coil_pulse_queue, then sleeps until the pulse is over

name: coil_pulse_now
evidence: starts a pulse in the coil's slot now; returns its handle

name: coil_pulse_now_wait
evidence: coil_pulse_now, then sleeps until the pulse is over

name: coil_pulse_queue_serve
evidence: OS loop: starts the queue's head when none runs (0x00031448); once over, the next waits a hold-off of 6 ticks (0x0003144c)

name: io_isr
evidence: the 4 kHz IO interrupt: 1 ms coil slot pass (time, patterns, end), switch rows (0x000368da), line sync, then motor_poll_all

name: flash_bank_set
evidence: writes the flash bank register (0x00031534 -> 0x02580000); returns the old bank (read back at 0x000315ec)

name: left_eject_callback
evidence: game device 3 callback (table 0x040d17fc +0xc): the Allspark award, warning 0x157 + leff 21 (case 7), eject 0x158 + leff 22 and coil 22

name: auto_launch_started
evidence: start callback of the queued auto-launch pulse (coil 2): leaf_abe8(0x3c, 0xbb) and task 0x45

name: trough_auto_launch
evidence: device callback: queues the auto-launch pulse (coil 2, 64 ms, coil_pulse_queue_wait) with auto_launch_started

name: trough_callback
evidence: device callback: case 9 queues a trough eject (coil 1, 64 ms, coil_pulse_queue_wait); case 0xe calls portal_mb_down_to_one_ball_user when fewer than 2 balls are left

name: allspark_mystery_award
